description: Curated initial inventory based on in-app Help. Route links require independent source/route checks; no runtime acceptance is implied.

features.name: Feature Trace
features.summary: Trace implementation and evidence across server, client, captures and packages.
features.purpose: Follow a behavior from a named feature to its most relevant implementation and evidence.
features.how_to_use: Start with a specific feature or behavior; inspect high-signal evidence and follow source links into related tools.
features.caveat: Use the runtime and evidence drill-down sections to narrow findings rather than treating every graph connection as equally relevant.

features.name: Behavior Inspector
features.summary: Inspect Lua-backed behavior, guards, callbacks and source evidence.

features.name: Feature Checker
features.summary: Check evidence coverage and required capabilities.

features.name: Capture Browser
features.summary: Inspect recorded packets, events, entities and timelines.
features.purpose: Research previously recorded client packets, events, entities, and timelines.
features.how_to_use: Open Captures, choose a capture package, and use the appropriate packet, event, entity, search, or spatial view.
features.caveat: Captured observations are evidence from a particular session; do not assume they prove general client behavior.

features.name: Key Items
features.summary: Browse key-item identities and static Lua evidence.
features.purpose: Examine key-item identities and how client/server data and scripts reference them.
features.how_to_use: Browse or search the Key Items page, then inspect the item's details and source references.
features.caveat: Historical TPZ script names and DSP behavior must not be conflated.

features.name: Auction House
features.summary: Auction House management, inspection and guarded operations.
features.purpose: Investigate and administer the DSP auction economy through read and guarded write workflows.
features.how_to_use: Use the Auction House module Help and select the sellers, buyers, restock, or cleanup workflow that matches the task.
features.caveat: Review item identity and server impact before invoking guarded mutations.

features.name: Live Client Bridge
features.summary: Inspect client bridge, telemetry and movement controls.
features.purpose: Inspect a connected Ashita bridge, real-time state, entity telemetry, and authorized movement controls.
features.how_to_use: Start at the bridge console, confirm client connection and zone, then choose live view or movement/validation controls.
features.caveat: Live telemetry and active control capabilities depend on the running addon and bridge configuration.

features.name: Synth & Crafting
features.summary: Browse recipes, ingredients and source availability.
features.purpose: Inspect recipes, ingredients, synthesis availability, and associated server evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open Synth & Crafting and select the recipe or ingredient area before reviewing source and availability.
features.caveat: Recipe presence does not independently establish that synthesis works in a live server.

features.name: Binary Inspector
features.summary: Inspect PE evidence, command probes and binary comparisons.
features.purpose: Inspect retail client executable and DLL metadata without executing the binaries.
features.how_to_use: Open Binary Inspector, select an isolated binary file, index its PE evidence, then compare build-specific indexes as needed.
features.caveat: A binary signature or cross-reference is evidence, not proof of a runtime behavior.

features.name: Validation
features.summary: Inspect validation runs and results.
features.purpose: Inspect planned and completed validation work with recorded results and evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open Validation, choose a run or target, then inspect results and unresolved checks.
features.caveat: Unrun tests are unknown, not failed; distinguish automated checks from live acceptance.

features.name: Research Sessions
features.summary: Record unresolved questions and supporting evidence.

features.name: ID Drift
features.summary: Compare server identifiers and migration mappings.

features.name: Entity Lookup
features.summary: Resolve server entity IDs and names and follow linked evidence.

features.name: SQL Browser
features.summary: Inspect indexed server SQL data and related records.

features.name: Client Overview
features.summary: Navigate client asset, DAT and binary inspection tools.

features.name: Packages
features.summary: Inspect migration packages and source evidence.

features.name: Wiki
features.summary: Browse cached wiki research and supporting source material.

features.name: Settings
features.summary: Configure Toolkit sources, profiles and local integrations.

features.name: Auction House browsing and history
features.summary: Inspect items, sellers, buyers, prices and activity.
features.purpose: Investigate historical and current Auction House item, seller, buyer, and transaction records.
features.how_to_use: Open Auction House and select the relevant browse or history tab; filter by item or seller and inspect the linked record.
features.caveat: Records reflect available server data; a missing result does not establish that a transaction never occurred.

features.name: Auction House economy insights
features.summary: Review economy health and market information.
features.purpose: Summarize auction activity, item supply, and other economy signals.
features.how_to_use: Open Economy, inspect its summary charts, then drill into underlying items before changing listings.
features.caveat: Aggregates are descriptive and should be verified against individual records before decisions.

features.name: Auction House item selection
features.summary: Use icon-backed item selection, browser links and contextual actions.
features.purpose: Select an exact item identity while retaining icons, names, and contextual links.
features.how_to_use: Use the shared item picker in the seller, buyer, restock or cleanup workflow; verify the selected ID before continuing.
features.caveat: Visual item names can be ambiguous; the selected item ID is authoritative.

features.name: Auction House preferences and exports
features.summary: Use remembered filters, favorites and read-only CSV exports.
features.purpose: Retain useful Auction House filters and selections and export read-only views.
features.how_to_use: Select filters or favorites in the relevant tab, then use CSV export for external review.
features.caveat: Exports are snapshots of the current filtered view, not backup/restore files.

features.name: Auction House restock and cleanup
features.summary: Preview guarded restock and cleanup operations.
features.purpose: Prepare and review controlled auction restock or cleanup changes.
features.how_to_use: Use the Restock or Cleanup tab, choose exact items, inspect the preview, and confirm the requested guarded operation.
features.caveat: Preview and authorization are required; do not treat a proposed change as already applied.

features.name: Auction House recovery journal
features.summary: Review durable case evidence and recipient attempt records; no automatic retry.
features.purpose: Investigate delivery and recovery cases with durable attempt evidence.
features.how_to_use: Open the recovery journal, select a case and inspect the recipient attempts and evidence before taking further action.
features.caveat: The journal does not automatically retry or complete recovery.

features.name: Auction House scheduled rewards
features.summary: Schedule cancellable Test-profile rewards with revalidation.
features.purpose: Configure cancellable, profile-restricted scheduled rewards.
features.how_to_use: Select a Test profile, review recipient and reward details, schedule the action, and verify status or cancellation.
features.caveat: Delivery revalidates guards at execution time; scheduling alone is not proof of delivery.

features.name: Auction House augmented rewards
features.summary: Configure and preview augments; experimental Test delivery requires acceptance.
features.purpose: Preview and configure item rewards with augment parameters.
features.how_to_use: Select an item and augments, inspect the generated reward preview and required acceptance conditions.
features.caveat: Experimental Test delivery requires acceptance; previews are not delivered items.

features.name: Ashita bridge telemetry
features.summary: Inspect receiver, sender configuration and live-client freshness.
features.purpose: Inspect the Ashita telemetry receiver, sender configuration, and event freshness.
features.how_to_use: Open the bridge console, identify the connected client, confirm the current zone and inspect heartbeat/freshness.
features.caveat: An absent or stale stream is not evidence that the client is offline; inspect bridge configuration first.

features.name: Live multi-entity streaming
features.summary: Reconcile observed entities with the live viewer and server evidence.
features.purpose: Inspect positions for multiple observed client entities and reconcile them with server records.
features.how_to_use: Connect the live bridge, open the entity-enabled map, compare live versus server markers, and inspect identity matches.
features.caveat: Live broadcasts depend on the installed addon and visibility; not every server spawn is a client observation.

features.name: Live movement and controls
features.summary: Use armed movement and STOP/disarm controls with zone and identity safeguards.
features.purpose: Use guarded movement assistance and immediate STOP/disarm controls.
features.how_to_use: Confirm client identity and zone, arm only the intended control, inspect movement feedback, then disarm or STOP.
features.caveat: Controls affect the live client and must remain scoped to an authorized development/testing session.

features.name: Live 3D zone integration
features.summary: Use player centering, zone switching, instance selection and live activity.
features.purpose: View the connected player's zone and observed activity within the external 3D map.
features.how_to_use: Select the correct zone and instance, follow or center the player, then compare live markers to static server evidence.
features.caveat: Geometry, static spawns, and live observations are separate layers with different provenance.

features.name: Feature Trace evidence dossier
features.summary: Review prioritized source and relationship evidence rather than raw graph breadth.
features.purpose: Build a focused evidence dossier identifying why a feature behaves as it does.
features.how_to_use: Enter a concrete feature or behavior in Feature Trace; review the prioritized sources, binding relationships, and source links.
features.caveat: Ranked evidence is not a claim that every adjacent graph node is causal.

features.name: Feature Trace runtime drill-down
features.summary: Inspect runtime paths and hierarchical behavior handoff.
features.purpose: Follow runtime and event handoffs through a hierarchical behavior path.
features.how_to_use: From a Feature Trace result, expand the runtime path and navigate each source or event handoff in order.
features.caveat: A predicted path is not a verified execution trace unless capture/runtime evidence exists.

features.name: Wiki cache and browsing
features.summary: Search and browse cached research with provenance.
features.purpose: Browse researched wiki content that has been imported and annotated with source provenance.
features.how_to_use: Search the Wiki module, open cached results, and inspect source and cache status before relying on the content.
features.caveat: Missing cache results may reflect import coverage, not absence from the original wiki.

features.name: Wiki bulk import and sync
features.summary: Manage background scrape/import jobs and cache health.
features.purpose: Control batch scraping and importing of research pages and observe cache health.
features.how_to_use: Open the Wiki import/sync controls, choose the source and bounded batch, then inspect job progress and errors.
features.caveat: Large batches need source-specific rate and error handling; imported pages require provenance.

features.name: Wiki translation research
features.summary: Inspect Japanese translation and client terminology evidence.
features.purpose: Review Japanese terminology and translation evidence for client-research comparisons.
features.how_to_use: Open the translation research view and compare the original term, proposed translation, and supporting sources.
features.caveat: Machine or inferred translations require independent corroboration.

features.name: Key Item Lua evidence
features.summary: Inspect require, grant and remove references and source paths.
features.purpose: Locate script references that grant, require, or remove a key item.
features.how_to_use: Open a key item's Lua evidence panel and inspect source paths, constants, and operation types.
features.caveat: A reference proves use in source, not that a complete quest progression is live-tested.

features.name: Item Browser
features.summary: Browse item records and inspect item data.

features.name: Item Editor
features.summary: Inspect and edit supported item data using guarded workflows.

features.name: Missions
features.summary: Browse mission and progression evidence.

features.name: Assault Tracker
features.summary: Track Assault issues, source evidence and validation gaps.
features.purpose: Track Assault missions, issue cross-references, shared dependencies, port status, and live-test readiness.
features.how_to_use: Open Assault, select a mission or zone, review the issue/fix-log evidence, and work from its next action.
features.caveat: Historical Topaz fixes do not automatically establish DSP fixes or validation.

features.name: Nyzul Isle
features.summary: Inspect Nyzul Isle domain data and related progression.

features.name: DAT Inspector

features.name: Retail Version Explorer
features.summary: Inspect retail manifest history and compare available versions.
features.purpose: Discover and selectively acquire versioned retail files for offline client research.
features.how_to_use: Open Retail Version Explorer, browse known files and revisions, then download into a dedicated research location before indexing.
features.caveat: Manifest history is not proof that every historical payload remains downloadable.

features.name: Retail Version Browser
features.summary: Browse discovered retail files and versions from a selected research snapshot.
features.purpose: Browse file identities and exact historical revisions from retail manifest snapshots.
features.how_to_use: Open the Retail Version Explorer's browse view, choose a file and listed revision, and inspect availability before selecting a download.
features.caveat: A listed historical revision does not guarantee that the remote payload still exists.
